surface: The sheets bar: its buttons, the tab strip, a switch to another sheet and its announcement, the sheet menu, and a rename.

steps.note: Tab leaves the grid for the bar's first control, the add sheet button. VoiceOver with WebKit said nothing on this first key, as on the first key of other scenarios.
The all sheets button, which opens a menu of the sheets.
The strip is one Tab stop, on the active sheet's tab, `Alpha`.
ArrowRight moves along the strip to the next tab, `Beta`, without switching to it.
Enter on an inactive tab switches to its sheet, and the plugin announces it (`Sheet Beta activated`, assertive).
Enter on the active tab opens its sheet menu, with the focus on its first item, Rename.
Rename opens the field over the tab, named `Sheet name`, holding the name selected. Finding: VoiceOver with WebKit reads only the value, `Beta`, not the field's name.
Typing replaces the selected name. Nothing is required: a reader may echo the keys.
Enter commits the name and puts the focus back on the tab, now `Budget`. The plugin announces only a rejected or unchanged name.

Shift+Tab goes back into the grid, now showing the Budget sheet, on its cell `B4`. The grid takes its name from the active tab, so a reader that names the grid it enters says `Budget`. NVDA with Firefox once said `Beta` here: the rename handed the label back without a change to `aria-labelledby`, so Firefox kept the old name, and the bar now writes the attribute again (`handsontable/src/plugins/sheetsBar/AGENTS.md`).
